title: The Amber Glutton's Hoard
story: Deep in the collapsed pine mine, Glimberack the Amber Glutton sits on a glittering pile of amber beads, refusing to let fourteen trapped diggers pass. Mr 6 offers him a riddle instead of a fight, and the beetle — who cannot resist a puzzle — loses badly and rolls off the hoard. Now the beads must be fairly shared.
question: The hoard holds 504 amber beads. One quarter of them goes to rebuilding the mine's broken ladder, and the rest is split equally among the 14 rescued diggers — how many beads does each digger get?
solution: The ladder takes 1/4 of 504 = 126 beads, so 504 - 126 = 378 beads remain.
praise: Splitting the hoard into parts was smart thinking — the piece that slipped away was sharing only what was LEFT after the ladder's quarter.
hint: Take out the ladder's quarter first, then divide the leftover among 14.
victory: Fourteen diggers walked out with 27 glowing beads each, and Glimberack cheerfully took the job of mine ladder inspector — he liked being counted on.
imagePrompt: A giant amber-crusted beetle slumps beside a mountain of glowing honey-colored beads in a lamplit collapsed mine while a small numeral-six knight sketches fractions on a slate for a circle of grateful diggers.
